title: Analysis code and data: Does the effect of type 2 diabetes and body mass index on cataract differ between East Asians and Europeans? A cross-ancestry Mendelian randomization study
description: R scripts, harmonized SNP-level data, all method-specific two-sample Mendelian randomization estimates and session information for a cross-ancestry study of type 2 diabetes and body mass index on cataract in Biobank Japan, UK Biobank, FinnGen and a UK Biobank plus FinnGen meta-analysis, using summary statistics from the IEU OpenGWAS database.
